labeler: blind independent review, generic OWASP rubric, no knowledge of the tool under test

labels.note: eval() is called directly on untrusted request body fields (req.body.preTax at line 32, req.body.afterTax at 33, req.body.roth at 34), giving server-side JavaScript injection / remote code execution.
The request handler builds a URL from user-controlled req.query.url and fetches it with needle.get (line 16), then streams the response body back to the client -- classic server-side request forgery.
The user-supplied 'threshold' value is interpolated unescaped into a MongoDB $where JavaScript expression, allowing NoSQL/JS injection (e.g. 0';while(true){}' ).

Passwords are stored in cleartext (the plaintext value from the request is inserted directly; the bcrypt hashing is commented out at line 29) and login compares them with a plain === at line 61 -- broken authentication / cleartext password storage.
The Swig template engine is configured with autoescape:false, so user-controlled fields (e.g. profile first/last name rendered in the views) are emitted unescaped, enabling stored/reflected XSS.
The express-session middleware is configured with no cookie options (the httpOnly/secure cookie block is commented out at lines 92-100), so the session cookie is set without HttpOnly or Secure flags.

No security-header middleware is registered: helmet is imported-but-commented (line 10) and the CSP/HSTS/frameguard/noSniff calls are all disabled, so the app ships without CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, or X-Content-Type-Options.
The application (which handles 401k/retirement PII) is served over plain HTTP via http.createServer; the HTTPS server is commented out (lines 149-155).

Hard-coded fallback secrets are committed in config: the session-signing cookieSecret (line 8) and a crypto key (line 9). These shipped default secrets are used to sign sessions when no env override is set.

notes: OWASP NodeGoat -- the canonical intentionally-vulnerable Express/MongoDB training app (recall case; NOT authored by us). Findings labeled purely from reading the source; each vulnerable line is left uncommented while the accompanying 'Fix for Ax' block is commented out. Nine distinct issues across OWASP Top 10 categories: eval RCE, SSRF, NoSQL $where injection, cleartext password storage, XSS via disabled template autoescaping, insecure session cookie, missing security headers, cleartext HTTP transit of PII, and hard-coded secrets. profile.js/profile-dao.js and session.js were also fetched for context (session.js login handler additionally lacks any brute-force rate limiting). MANIFEST TRIMMED (0.3.1, ERR-007): repo/package.json keeps only the dependencies project_model.mjs can read (see bench/wild/observable-packages.mjs), at their real upstream versions -- the rest were deleted because they are invisible to every engine pass and each one raised a Dependabot alert against a fixture that is never installed. No version was changed, and no label here is a dependency label, so nothing this case measures moves.
